title: Buy
body:
Syntax: buy <item>

Description: Purchases an item from a shopkeeper in the room. Your level must be at least the item's level; if it is too low, the purchase is refused without charging you. Use 'list' to see prices and item level requirements.

'buy apartment' and 'buy room <type> <direction>' are special cases -- see 'help apartment' for details. At your own village's Kage chamber, 'buy' also purchases village-wide perks and legendary items from the Kage instead -- see 'help legendary items'.

Date: 2026-08-17
